description_en: Starts a real-time synchronization task or a synchronization solution
description_zh: 调用StartDISyncInstance接口，启动实时同步任务和解决方案同步任务
name: StartDISyncInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID. You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。
该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object that you want to start. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task
DI_SOLUTION: data synchronization solution
parameters.help_zh:
启动数据集成同步任务的任务类型。 目前仅支持使用DI_REALTIME和DI_SOLUTION两种类型：
DI_REALTIME代表启动实时任务。
DI_SOLUTION代表启动解决方案
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
If you set TaskType to DI_REALTIME, set this parameter to the ID of the real-time synchronization task that you want to start.
If you set TaskType to DI_SOLUTION, set this parameter to the ID of the data synchronization solution that you want to start
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType参数配置为DI_REALTIME，则FileId为实时同步任务的任务ID。
当TaskType参数配置为DI_SOLUTION，则FileId为解决方案同步任务的任务ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en:
If you set TaskType to DI_REALTIME, the StartParam parameter specifies the startup parameters for the real-time synchronization task. The startup parameters include failover-related parameters, the parameter that specifies the number of dirty data records allowed, and the parameters in the data definition language (DDL) statements.
If you set TaskType to DI_SOLUTION, the StartParam parameter does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
当TaskType参数配置为DI_REALTIME，则StartParam为实时同步任务的启动参数，包括Failover的设置，脏数据条数，以及DDL的参数配置。
当TaskType参数配置为DI_SOLUTION，则StartParam参数无意义
parameters.name: start_param

Data.description_en: The result returned for the start

Message.description_en:
The reason why the real-time synchronization task or the data synchronization solution fails to be started.

If the real-time synchronization task or the data synchronization solution is started, the value null is returned
Message.description_zh:
启动数据集成同步任务失败后的原因描述。

如果启动数据集成同步任务成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the real-time synchronization task or the data synchronization solution is started. Valid values:

success: The real-time synchronization task or the data synchronization solution is started.
fail: The real-time synchronization task or the data synchronization solution fails to be started. You can troubleshoot the issue based on the provided cause
Status.description_zh:
启动同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：同步任务启动成功。
fail：同步任务启动失败。您可以查看具体原因，处理相关问题

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
